capabilities: Display Base summaries as cards instead of rows
Configure card width and height per view
Group summary cards by a Base property
Choose a summary for each property via a summary editor
extras: Includes a ready-made demo vault (/summary-only-demo-vault) with a guided walkthrough; install instructions are aimed at developers building from source.
intentEvidence: SummaryOnly adds a Summary only view to Obsidian Bases.
problem: Bases shows summaries only alongside full table rows, so users who just want the aggregate values cannot get a clean summary display.
summary: Adds a Summary only view to Obsidian Bases that hides table rows and displays summary values as cards.
